products.name: LlamaIndex
products.note: RAG framework; data connectors; indexing strategies; enterprise RAG governance

profile_text.body:
LlamaIndex is a software company that develops tools for building AI-powered document and data workflows. Its primary offering is LlamaIndex, described by the site as a RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) framework that provides data connectors, indexing strategies, and enterprise RAG governance. The company also produces LlamaParse, which it describes as an agentic OCR product for processing complex documents containing tables, charts, and images, and a separate open-source document parsing library that works without cloud services or LLM tokens.

The company positions LlamaParse as suitable for enterprise document automation, covering parsing, extraction, indexing, and retrieval. The site highlights use cases across financial services, including banks, hedge funds, and fintechs using the tools for financial research, due diligence, and invoice processing, as well as manufacturers extracting information from specifications and inspection reports, and healthcare providers handling medical records, handwritten notes, and insurance claims.

The site's held facts confirm LlamaIndex is tracked as a single product in the coding and developer tools category. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
